slot.brief: Photochemical smog or ozone-depletion: which pollutants (NOx, CFCs, PAN) contribute and the reactions involved

stem: In sunlight-driven urban air, which reaction sequence accounts for ozone formation in photochemical smog?

verdicts.working: NO₂ photolysis produces atomic O, which combines with O₂ in the presence of a third body M to form O₃. This is sequence (A).

working:
$\text{NO}_2 \xrightarrow{h\nu} \text{NO} + \text{O}$
$\text{O} + \text{O}_2 + \text{M} \rightarrow \text{O}_3 + \text{M}$

Independent check: NO₂ photolysis produces atomic O, which combines with O₂ in the presence of a third body M to form O₃. This is sequence (A).
solution:
Photolysis of nitrogen dioxide produces atomic oxygen, which combines with molecular oxygen in the presence of a third body to form ozone:
$$\text{NO}_2 \xrightarrow{h\nu} \text{NO} + \text{O}, \qquad \text{O} + \text{O}_2 + \text{M} \rightarrow \text{O}_3 + \text{M}$$
